inheritance.law: Every prior completed entry, blocker, named program, goal, privacy boundary, authority boundary, evidence receipt and historical classification remains inherited by Git history and this exact blob reference unless explicitly superseded below. Omission from this compact checkpoint is not deletion.

startupLaw: A session may be new; UberBond may not be new. Refresh live main before present-tense claims, then mount the canonical Context Fabric/Brainstate and reconcile open PRs, exact-current runtime/provider receipts, CURRENT_HANDOFF and executable terminal truth. Read AGENTS.md, NORTH_STAR.md, UBERBOND_CANON.md, UBERBOND_BOOTSTRAP.json, master memory/index and inherited handoffs before narrowing scope. A stale handoff is a retrieval pointer, never authority to overwrite newer executable truth. Capability never creates authority.
activeMission: PROJECT NULLSTAR OMEGA (339 sections). Every section that does not require founder consent, identity, money, a customer, a legal fact, a physical action, an unavailable credential, provider acceptance or real elapsed time has been executed. The change that matters: the evaluation instrument stopped reading its own answers. G0 through G2 all scored 1.0 on every dimension because each corpus task was a direct read of a value the repository computes for itself. G3 measures outcomes instead -- whether a sealed forecast was right, whether a named symptom resolved, whether a mechanism survived a new family -- and separates at 0.60, 0 and 0.33, spread 1, mean 0.77. Run npm run omega:cycle then omega:reality, omega:meta, omega:generalization and omega:g3 before selecting cognitive work, and read artifacts/nullstar-omega/bottlenecks-G3.json rather than assuming the answer is more dimensions -- that was the G1 mistake and it cost two generations.

remainingSovereignCuts.law: No remaining cut may be closed by source claims, simulations, sandbox payments, same-provider substitution, cloned receipts, repository text, or another cut's evidence.

reconciliation.missingIsUpperBound: The matcher will not split a title on whitespace, so a section implemented under a different repository name reads MISSING until a reviewed alias says otherwise. Six aliases moved 253 to 247. Reduce it further with more reviewed aliases, never by loosening the matcher.
reconciliation.aliasLaw: An alias supplies only which repository name to search under; the state is still computed from what that search finds, and an alias that stops resolving fails the compile rather than reverting its row to MISSING.

Two callers of enforcement decisions (sovereign-local-promotion, sovereign-native-local-worker) sat outside SOVEREIGNTY_PROTECTED_PATHS and could have discarded the decision. FIRST_CASH_OFFER.sku feeds requiresExactSku on the PayPal order a buyer approves and nothing asserted it.

Five mutation anchors pointed at text that no longer existed, so five guards were silently untested. Re-anchored; two then survived, which found a missing SKU test and a redundant integrity check absorbing its own mutation. All five now kill.

A derivation rule matched the word 'survived' inside guard descriptions WAR-02, LKG-04 and FCSTACK-07 and read the mutation catalogue as the result, against an actual 397 killed 0 not killed; that loop is voided rather than rescored, because the answer is now known and a replacement forecast would measure memory. A second observer read config/reachability-classification.json, the file this session used to park those modules, so the observation was scored against its own prior declaration; the declared rule always said the import graph, so the observer was repaired and returned the same answer independently.

The G2 diagnosis named the cause and G3 acted on it; that symptom resolved. Retrospective episodes can show a process failing and cannot show it succeeding.

NULLSTAR OMEGA COGNITIVE MEASUREMENT IS PROVIDER-GATED, AND THE GATE IS NARROWER THAN G2 SAID: re-probing split it. Opening the network alone would not make a model selectable. This gates capability-by-judgement scoring only; bottleneck discovery, generalization, meta-improvement, reality calibration, life transfer and economic transfer were blocked by association in the G2 verdict and are not. All six are now done. Evidence: artifacts/nullstar-omega/G2-discriminating-test.json v1.1.

FIRST REALITY-CALIBRATED DIMENSION IS EARNED; THE REST ARE NOT. N12 CALIBRATION now sits at REALITY_CALIBRATED on 2 closed loops with mean Brier 0.7975 and 2 surprises out of 2. The other 23 dimensions sit at VERIFIED or OPERATING and still have no prediction checked against a later observation.
